description: Repeat a `cycle` of steps (open and close a level, add and remove objects: e.g. {"type":"eval","js":"app.load(); app.unload()"}) several times with garbage collection after each, and report what grows per cycle: GPU geometries, textures and programs, scene objects, scenes still alive, JS heap, and the resources that reached the GPU and were never disposed, by type (SphereGeometry, MeshStandardMaterial, Texture robot.png).
